gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.804431 26.21589)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
aspect_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(a.rast, 1, o.pt) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_rast a, origin o;

```sql
WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'The Baker Museum'
    AND addr_city ILIKE 'Naples'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'FL'
),
aspect_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Azimuth(
      ST_Centroid(ST_Envelope(r.rast)),
      ST_Centroid(ST_Union(ST_Clip(r.rast, p.geom, TRUE)))
    ) * (180 / pi()) AS aspect_degrees
  FROM public.dem_us r
  CROSS JOIN poi_geom p
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geom)
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(aspect_degrees) AS aspect_degrees
FROM aspect_analysis;
```
